# Welcome to #🕹️-open-z80
This channel is for **FOSSi Z80**, @ReJ aka Renaldas Zioma's open-source, pin compatible replacement for the classic Zilog Z80 8-bit CPU, and the chips made on wafer.space runs. @ReJ aka Renaldas Zioma looks after this channel.

**Chips**
- Run 1: [RZ80](<https://wafer.space/ws-run1/projects/RZ80.html>) (1x1 slot) and [HZ80](<https://wafer.space/ws-run1/projects/HZ80.html>) (0.5x1 slot)
- Run 2: [HZ80](<https://wafer.space/ws-run2/projects/HZ80.html>) (0.5x1 slot) and [QZ80](<https://wafer.space/ws-run2/projects/QZ80.html>) (0.5x0.5 slot)

**Source**
- [z80-open-silicon](<https://github.com/rejunity/z80-open-silicon>)
- [ws0-z80-open-silicon-gf180mcu](<https://github.com/rejunity/ws0-z80-open-silicon-gf180mcu>)

**Background** (from the earlier Tiny Tapeout 07 version)
- [Slides: Z80 on Tiny Tapeout](<https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1-vcqAm9nMe9o_P5PAofOEgkbrVqfZs-Lbs7DuWj7h2o>)
- [Video with Matt Venn](<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GI1e22A2J3U>)

If you have one of these chips, please post your bring-up results, boards, test code and questions here.
